spell.absolutemagic.fixed_damage.guide: For a while, every tool hit and spell hit adds a flat amount of true damage. The extra damage ignores other damage buffs (enchantments, relics, skill tree, spell power), armor and resistances.
spell.absolutemagic.percent_damage.guide: For a while, every tool hit and spell hit adds true damage equal to a percentage of the target's HP. The extra damage ignores other damage buffs, armor and resistances.
spell.absolutemagic.time_bomb.guide: Plant a time bomb on the creature you aim at. After a short fuse it explodes without destroying blocks. A player dies; a mob takes fixed true damage but is not killed outright. A bombed player who hits another player passes the bomb on.
